headline_rule.spread: Bet the side where |model_margin - closing_spread_line| >= 2.0 points (side = model's side of the line).
headline_rule.total: Bet over/under where |model_total - closing_total_line| >= 3.0 points (direction = model's side).
headline_rule.lines_source: nflverse/Lee Sharpe schedules (games.csv) spread_line (home-margin convention) and total_line
headline_rule.pushes: excluded from win rate, counted separately

holdout_policy: All hyperparameters and regression coefficients frozen using 2016-2021 only. Holdout graded once with the locked rule; that is the headline result.
walk_forward_policy: Each week's projection uses only games before that week: current-season ratings through week-1, priors from strictly earlier seasons, model params frozen from tuning window.
tuning_objective: Leave-one-season-out MAE vs final margin within 2016-2021 (ATS-free; no line data used in tuning).
